article_title: Two arrested after people seen mysteriously emerging from various New York City sewers

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Two men were arrested after leaving New York sewers, amid several similar incidents and safety concerns.
New York plans to turn its sewer system into a public tourist route.
Police proved that a political attack had been planned near the United Nations.
The city is replacing every manhole after a major engineering failure.
tasks.correct_answer: Two men were arrested after leaving New York sewers, amid several similar incidents and safety concerns.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתמקדת במעצר שני גברים שיצאו ממערכת הביוב, באירועים דומים ובאזהרות מפני הסכנה שבכניסה לביוב.

tasks.prompt: Why did the NYPD carry out additional security sweeps?
options: A storm had flooded every street in Manhattan.
The incident happened near a sensitive location during the UN General Assembly.
The arrested men said they had found a dangerous gas leak.
A hotel asked police to search for missing valuables.
tasks.correct_answer: The incident happened near a sensitive location during the UN General Assembly.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: המשטרה אמרה שהאירוע התאים למקרים של חיפוש גרוטאות, אך נקטה זהירות נוספת בגלל העצרת הכללית של האו״ם ורגישות המקום.

tasks.prompt: In the report, what does “an abundance of caution” mean?
options: A shortage of police officers
A legal order to close the streets
Taking more precautions than usual to reduce risk
A large amount of valuable metal underground
tasks.correct_answer: Taking more precautions than usual to reduce risk
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי an abundance of caution פירושו נקיטת אמצעי זהירות רבים במיוחד כדי לצמצם סיכון.

tasks.prompt: What happened to Kevin Rodriguez and Samuel Reveron after their Friday hearing?
options: They were sent to federal prison immediately.
They admitted entering the sewer to steal metal.
They remained missing after fleeing the scene.
They pleaded not guilty and were released from custody.
tasks.correct_answer: They pleaded not guilty and were released from custody.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי רישומי בית המשפט, השניים כפרו באשמה ושוחררו ממעצר לאחר הדיון.

tasks.prompt: What explanation did police give for several people entering the sewer system after storms?
options: They may have been searching for valuables and scrap metal.
They were inspecting pipes for the city.
They were filming an official documentary.
They were using a legal underground shortcut.
tasks.correct_answer: They may have been searching for valuables and scrap metal.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ה־NYPD מסר כי היו מקרים שבהם אנשים נכנסו למערכת הביוב לאחר סערה כדי לחפש חפצי ערך וגרוטאות מתכת.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article mention toxic gases, flooding and confined spaces?
options: To explain why officers wear blue overalls
To show why sewer metal is expensive
To support the warning that entering sewers is dangerous as well as illegal
To prove that the arrested men caused a flood
tasks.correct_answer: To support the warning that entering sewers is dangerous as well as illegal
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסיכונים האלה מסבירים מדוע הרשויות מזהירות את הציבור שלא להיכנס לצינורות, לניקוזים או לבורות ביוב.

tasks.prompt: Give two details showing that the September arrests were part of a wider pattern.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני אירועים קודמים שונים מן הכתבה ולתאר בקצרה מה נראה בכל אחד.
expected_points: In August, surveillance footage showed someone emerging from a manhole in Queens.
Also in August, three people in overalls and headlamps were seen climbing from a manhole near Penn Station.
In May, a group was filmed moving a manhole cover and climbing into a sewer in South Brooklyn.

tasks.prompt: Why were police cautious about the incident without saying it was a political plot?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את שני צדי השיקול: ההסבר הרגיל של חיפוש חפצים והרגישות הביטחונית של הזמן והמקום.
expected_points: Police said the incident matched earlier cases involving people looking for valuables or scrap metal.
The manhole was near a hotel where Benjamin Netanyahu was reportedly expected during the UN General Assembly.
Because the location and timing were sensitive, police and federal partners conducted extra sweeps.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the arrests, the police response and the public-safety warning.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: הסיכום צריך לכלול מי נעצר ומדוע, מדוע נערכו סריקות נוספות, ומהן הסכנות המרכזיות בכניסה לביוב.
expected_points: Two Queens men were arrested on conspiracy and trespassing charges after allegedly leaving a manhole and fleeing.
Police treated the location with extra caution during the UN General Assembly and worked with federal partners.
Officials warned that sewer entry is illegal and can expose people to toxic gas, flooding and confined-space hazards.

tasks.prompt: Using evidence from the article, explain how officials balanced investigation with public reassurance.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג טענה ברורה, להביא לפחות שתי ראיות מן הכתבה ולהבחין בין בדיקת סיכון ביטחוני לבין המסקנה הזהירה של המשטרה.
expected_points: Officials conducted additional security sweeps because of the UN event and sensitive location.
Police also said the incident fit a known pattern of people searching sewers for valuables or scrap.
The article reports charges and alleged conduct without claiming that a larger political conspiracy was proved.
The safety warning gives the public practical reasons to stay out of sewers.
